newsitem.title: UK: UK agent books 6 cargo flights due to Spain strike.
newsitem.headline: UK agent books 6 cargo flights due to Spain strike.

text.p: London Stansted Airport-based Artac Freight Forwarding said it has organised six cargo charter flights between Spain and the UK over the past week for customers hit by the 13-day-old Spanish lorry drivers' strike.

"They have been chartered mainly on behalf of motor vehicle manufacturers which, because they adhere to strict just-in-time delivery procedures, are affected by strikes such as this one quicker than other industries," Artac's charter manager Andy Bailey told Reuters.
He said the six flights had been operated from several points in Spain, including Valencia, to Stansted, East Midlands and Manston airports in the UK.

Aircraft used have included 40-tonne capacity IL-76s and 18-tonne capacity AN-12s and HeavyLift Cargo Airlines was one of the carriers used, said Bailey, who declined to give further contract details.

"We have no more orders presently on our books for charter flights required because of the Spanish drivers' strike. But in the business you can't tell what will happen from one hour to the next," he said.
